experiment: F18 controlled-degradation ladders: construct validity of Linux-measurable capture-envelope dimensions on E15 downstream-good units (ground truth by construction)

criteria.claim: Short side < 720px degrades and < 480px breaks downstream pose/track quality.

constructValidity.test: Downscale ladder (short side native→720→640→480→360→240) on downstream-good units; measured short side must equal the encoded short side exactly and band status must flip exactly at 719/479.
constructValidity.validates: Measured value tracks ground truth 1:1 and band edges bind where written.
constructValidity.refutes: Any measured short side deviating from the encoded value (probe reads rotation/storage wrong).

predictiveValidity.test: Re-run pose extraction + mining on the downscale ladder; find the short side where track fragmentation/pose loss actually rises.
predictiveValidity.validates: Failure onset within [480, 720] confirms both edges; onset elsewhere refutes the placement.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Downstream survival at 360px or failure at 720px.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: Alternatively ≥10 labeled units per bin {<480, 480–719, ≥720} from ≥5 independent sessions each; corpus has zero labeled units below 720.

criteria.claim: avg fps ≥ 24 is analyzable; 15–23 degrades; < 15 breaks event/contact timing.

constructValidity.test: fps-decimation ladder (24→20→15→12→10→8) on downstream-good units; measured avg fps must equal the target within container rounding, and band status must flip exactly at 23.x/14.x.
constructValidity.validates: Probe's avg_frame_rate tracks true decoded rate across containers.
constructValidity.refutes: Measured fps diverging from encoded fps.

predictiveValidity.test: Re-run downstream analysis on the fps ladder of known-good clips; locate the fps where contact-timing error/event recall actually collapses.
predictiveValidity.validates: Collapse onset in [15, 24) confirms the degraded band; survival at 12 or collapse at 24 refutes it.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Downstream completion at 8–12 fps or failure at 24 fps.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: Alternatively ≥10 labeled units per bin {<15, 15–23, ≥24} from ≥5 sessions each; corpus has zero labeled real clips between 8 and 24 fps.

criteria.claim: Mean luma inside [60, 200] is analyzable; [40, 220] degraded; outside breaks detection.

constructValidity.test: eq=brightness shift ladder (±0.1/±0.2/±0.3 normalized) on downstream-good units; measured mean luma must move monotonically with the injected shift (≈255·shift before clipping) and cross the 60/200 edges where arithmetic predicts.
constructValidity.validates: Luma probe responds monotonically and predictably to real exposure change.
constructValidity.refutes: Non-monotonic or unresponsive measured luma under known injected shifts.

predictiveValidity.test: Downstream reruns on the brightness ladder; find the luma where pose/ball detection actually fails.
predictiveValidity.validates: Failure onset outside [60, 200] on both tails confirms; failure inside or survival far outside refutes.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Downstream survival at luma < 40 or > 220, or failure inside [60, 200].
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: Alternatively ≥10 labeled units per tail bin {<60, >200} from ≥5 sessions; corpus luma range on labeled units is entirely inside the supported band.

criteria.claim: Median Laplacian variance @320w ≥ 100 is sharp; 30–99 degraded; < 30 too blurred.

constructValidity.test: Gaussian-blur ladder (sigma@320w 0.5→1→2→4) on downstream-good units; measured Laplacian variance must decrease strictly monotonically with sigma, and the sigma at which each unit crosses 100/30 is recorded.
constructValidity.validates: The proxy orders real blur severities correctly on real footage.
constructValidity.refutes: Non-monotonic variance under increasing injected blur.

predictiveValidity.test: Downstream reruns on the blur ladder; find the variance at which paddle/ball tracking actually degrades.
predictiveValidity.validates: Failure onset in [30, 100) confirms both edges.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Downstream survival below variance 30 or failure above 100.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: Alternatively ≥10 labeled units per bin {<30, 30–99, ≥100} from ≥5 sessions; every labeled corpus unit measured ≥ 100.

criteria.claim: Mean abs frame diff @320w ≤ 33 indicates a stable-enough camera; 34–46 degraded; > 46 unsupported. Implicit construct claim: the proxy measures CAMERA motion.

constructValidity.test: Inject known global camera motion (sinusoidal crop-path pan, amplitude 0/1/2/4/8/16 px @320w, 1.5 Hz) into downstream-good units; compare measured diff against each unit's own zero-injection control and against the subject-motion-only control range across units.
constructValidity.validates: Measured diff separates injected-camera-motion clips from subject-motion-only controls at some amplitude below the supported edge.
constructValidity.refutes: Subject-motion-only controls spanning the supported edge, or realistic handheld amplitudes (1–4 px @320w) remaining inside the control range — the proxy then cannot distinguish camera from subject motion and the band is construct-invalid regardless of placement.

predictiveValidity.test: Downstream reruns on the injected-pan ladder; find the amplitude where tracking actually breaks, then map it through the proxy.
predictiveValidity.validates: Breakage onset mapping to diff ≈ 33–46 confirms; otherwise refutes.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Tracking survival at diff > 46 or breakage at diff < 33.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: Alternatively ≥10 labeled units per bin {≤33, 34–46, >46} from ≥5 sessions with known camera-mount type; corpus has 9 good units from 3 sessions, none above 33.

criteria.claim: Frame-interval CV ≤ 0.15 is stable; 0.16–0.35 degraded; > 0.35 unsupported.

constructValidity.test: Requires re-muxing clips with controlled PTS jitter; ffmpeg 4.4.2 lacks a per-packet timestamp-jitter path that preserves decodability (setts bsf not available), so no trustworthy injection exists here.

predictiveValidity.test: Labeled VFR clips (phone captures) spanning CV 0.15–0.5 with downstream outcomes.
predictiveValidity.validates: Failure rate rising across the 0.15/0.35 edges.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: ≥10 labeled VFR units per bin {≤0.15, 0.16–0.35, >0.35} from ≥5 sessions; all current labeled units are CFR broadcast/DVIDS footage with CV ≈ 0.

criteria.claim: 2–90 s clips are analyzable; 1–2 s or 90–180 s degraded; outside unsupported.

constructValidity.test: Duration is read directly from the container/window — construct validity is definitional (verified incidentally by every windowed measurement in E15).

predictiveValidity.test: Product-level: does analysis produce a usable Result on sub-2 s clips? This is an analysis-pipeline invariant (insufficient events), not a capture-quality property.
predictiveValidity.validates: Downstream event count vs clip length curve.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Usable results on sub-1 s clips.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: ≥10 labeled units per duration bin from ≥5 sessions.

criteria.claim: Target player ≥ 25% of frame height is analyzable; 12–25% degraded; below unsupported.

constructValidity.test: Requires pose output (Apple Vision) to measure the proxy at all; NOT_MEASURED on Linux.

predictiveValidity.test: Downscale/distance ladder with pose reruns on Mac; find the player-height fraction where joint recall collapses.
predictiveValidity.refutes: Pose survival below 0.12 or collapse above 0.25.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: ≥10 pose-measured labeled units per bin from ≥5 sessions; zero exist.

criteria.claim: Mean joint visibility ≥ 0.5 is analyzable; 0.3–0.5 degraded; below unsupported.

constructValidity.test: Requires pose output (Apple Vision); NOT_MEASURED on Linux.

predictiveValidity.test: Occlusion ladder with pose reruns on Mac.
predictiveValidity.corpusRequirement: ≥10 pose-measured labeled units per bin from ≥5 sessions; zero exist.

method.tooling: ffmpeg version 4.4.2-0ubuntu0.22.04.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2021 the FFmpeg developers
method.sourceUnits: the 9 E15 downstream-good units (7 corpus scenes from 2 DVIDS recordings, sha-verified re-downloads; 1 committed bundle clip); held-out cases and fresh-candidate clips never touched
method.control: each unit re-encoded once (libx264 crf18) as the shared control; every ladder step derives from that control so codec effects cancel
method.grouping: rows carry sessionKey (3 independent sessions); no random-frame splits
